verdict.rationale: Datalab documents its own registrable outbound HTTP webhooks. You configure a default webhook URL, can override it per request with a webhook_url parameter, and receive real-time notifications when processing jobs complete instead of polling. The only documented event is job completion, and there is no evidence of an event catalog, per-event subscription, signature verification, or retry semantics. Missing for 10: multiple subscribable event types, payload signing/verification docs, delivery retry guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks provide real-time notifications when your document processing jobs complete, eliminating the need for continuous polling.
Configure webhooks to receive real-time notifications when Datalab jobs complete.
You can override the default webhook URL for specific API requests by including the webhook_url parameter
